```{r setup}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()
REPO_ROOT <- if (basename(SCRIPT_DIR) == "oklahoma" &&
                  basename(dirname(SCRIPT_DIR)) == "inst") {
  normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..", ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
} else {
  normalizePath(SCRIPT_DIR, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}
if (file.exists(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
    requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(REPO_ROOT, quiet = TRUE, export_all = FALSE,
                    helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
scalar_chr <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) < 1L) return("N/A")
  as.character(x[[1]])
}
safe_num <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(v) < 1L) return(NA_real_)
  v <- v[[1]]
  if (is.finite(v)) v else NA_real_
}
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 4) {
  x <- safe_num(x)
  if (!is.finite(x)) "N/A" else format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE)
}
fmt_ate <- function(x) {
  x <- safe_num(x)
  if (!is.finite(x)) "N/A" else sprintf("%.1f", x)
}

results_path <- trimws(Sys.getenv("OK_RESULTS_FILE", ""))
if (!nzchar(results_path)) {
  out_dir <- PPDisentangle::pp_output_path("oklahoma", repo_root = REPO_ROOT)
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(out_dir, "oklahoma_cd_current.rds"),
    file.path(out_dir, "for_paper.rds"),
    file.path(out_dir, "oklahoma_results.rds")
  )
  existing <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(existing)) stop("Set OK_RESULTS_FILE or place oklahoma_cd_current.rds under output/oklahoma/")
  results_path <- existing[[1]]
}
results <- readRDS(results_path)
cfg <- results$config %||% list()
meta <- results$metadata %||% list()

prev_path <- trimws(Sys.getenv("OK_CD_PREV_RESULTS_FILE", ""))
prev <- NULL
if (nzchar(prev_path) && file.exists(prev_path)) {
  prev <- readRDS(prev_path)
}

fit_obj <- function(res, letter) {
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$fits_named)) return(NULL)
  res$fits_named[[letter]]
}
pick_ate <- function(ate_obj, contrast = "all_or_nothing") {
  if (is.null(ate_obj)) return(NULL)
  bc <- ate_obj$by_contrast
  if (is.list(bc) && !is.null(bc[[contrast]])) return(bc[[contrast]])
  if (!is.null(ate_obj$contrast) &&
      identical(as.character(ate_obj$contrast)[1], contrast)) {
    return(ate_obj)
  }
  if (identical(contrast, "all_or_nothing") && !is.null(ate_obj$all_nothing_sim)) {
    return(ate_obj)
  }
  NULL
}
ate_saved <- function(ate_obj, contrast = "all_or_nothing") {
  a <- pick_ate(ate_obj, contrast)
  if (is.null(a) || is.null(a$all_nothing_sim)) return(numeric())
  sim <- a$all_nothing_sim
  if ("total_saved" %in% names(sim)) return(as.numeric(sim$total_saved))
  if ("total_effect" %in% names(sim)) return(as.numeric(sim$total_effect))
  numeric()
}
ate_summary <- function(ate_obj, contrast = "all_or_nothing") {
  s <- ate_saved(ate_obj, contrast)
  s <- s[is.finite(s)]
  list(
    mean = if (length(s)) mean(s) else NA_real_,
    sd = if (length(s) > 1L) stats::sd(s) else NA_real_,
    n = length(s)
  )
}
fit_rho <- function(fit, beta_gr) {
  p <- if (!is.null(fit)) fit$params else NULL
  beta <- safe_num(beta_gr)
  if (is.null(p) || !is.finite(beta)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(
    PPDisentangle:::.etas_biv_spectral_radius(p, beta),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}
param_vec <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$params)) return(NULL)
  p <- unlist(fit$params)
  p[is.finite(p)]
}

fit_C <- fit_obj(results, "C")
fit_D <- fit_obj(results, "D")
prev_C <- fit_obj(prev, "C")
prev_D <- fit_obj(prev, "D")
```

# Run identity

```{r tbl-identity}
id_df <- data.frame(
  Field = c(
    "Results file",
    "Job id",
    "Saved at",
    "Git / stage",
    "Previous (compare) file"
  ),
  Value = c(
    results_path,
    scalar_chr(meta$job_id %||% cfg$JOB_ID %||% NA),
    scalar_chr(meta$saved_at %||% NA),
    paste(scalar_chr(meta$stage), scalar_chr(meta$git_sha %||% meta$commit), sep = " / "),
    if (nzchar(prev_path) && file.exists(prev_path)) prev_path else "(none)"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
kable(id_df, align = "lc", caption = "Current C/D run identity.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

# Fit C / D ATEs

Positive `saved = N(control) - N(treated)` means the treatment regime saved earthquakes.

```{r tbl-ates}
ate_row <- function(letter, fit, contrast) {
  s <- ate_summary(if (!is.null(fit)) fit$ate else NULL, contrast)
  data.frame(
    Fit = letter,
    Label = scalar_chr(fit$label %||% letter),
    Contrast = contrast,
    `Mean saved` = fmt_ate(s$mean),
    `SD saved` = fmt_ate(s$sd),
    `ATE sims` = as.character(s$n),
    rho = fmt_num(fit_rho(fit, cfg$BETA_GR), 4),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
ate_df <- rbind(
  ate_row("C", fit_C, "all_or_nothing"),
  ate_row("D", fit_D, "all_or_nothing"),
  ate_row("C", fit_C, "observed"),
  ate_row("D", fit_D, "observed")
)
kable(ate_df, align = "lllllll",
      caption = "C/D ATE summaries (bivariate law).") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

# Fit C / D parameters

```{r tbl-params}
param_order <- c(
  "mu_0", "mu_1",
  "A_00", "alpha_m_00", "A_11", "alpha_m_11",
  "A_01", "alpha_m_01", "A_10", "alpha_m_10",
  "c", "p", "D", "gamma", "q"
)
pc <- param_vec(fit_C)
pd <- param_vec(fit_D)
nms <- unique(c(param_order, names(pc), names(pd)))
nms <- nms[nms %in% unique(c(names(pc), names(pd)))]
# Keep preferred order first
nms <- c(intersect(param_order, nms), setdiff(nms, param_order))
params_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = nms,
  C = vapply(nms, function(nm) fmt_num(pc[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
  D = vapply(nms, function(nm) fmt_num(pd[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
kable(params_df, align = "lrr",
      caption = "C (naive biv+KDE all-free) and D (SEM biv+KDE all-free) parameters.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

# Diff vs previous (if provided)

```{r tbl-diff}
#| label: tbl-diff
if (is.null(prev)) {
  cat("No previous C/D RDS set (`OK_CD_PREV_RESULTS_FILE`). Re-run via `launch_oklahoma_cd_update_nesi.sh` to populate diffs.\n")
} else {
  prev_cfg <- prev$config %||% list()
  diff_settings <- data.frame(
    Setting = c("SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS", "SEM_INNER_ITER", "SEM_OUTER_MAXIT_BIV", "ATE_N_SIMS", "BETA_GR"),
    Previous = c(
      fmt_num(prev_cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS, 4),
      scalar_chr(prev_cfg$SEM_INNER_ITER %||% prev_cfg$SEM_INNER),
      scalar_chr(prev_cfg$SEM_OUTER_MAXIT_BIV),
      scalar_chr(prev_cfg$ATE_N_SIMS),
      fmt_num(prev_cfg$BETA_GR, 6)
    ),
    Current = c(
      fmt_num(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS, 4),
      scalar_chr(cfg$SEM_INNER_ITER %||% cfg$SEM_INNER),
      scalar_chr(cfg$SEM_OUTER_MAXIT_BIV),
      scalar_chr(cfg$ATE_N_SIMS),
      fmt_num(cfg$BETA_GR, 6)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  kable(diff_settings, align = "lrr",
        caption = "Settings: previous vs current.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

  ate_diff_row <- function(letter, cur_fit, prev_fit, contrast) {
    cur <- ate_summary(if (!is.null(cur_fit)) cur_fit$ate else NULL, contrast)
    old <- ate_summary(if (!is.null(prev_fit)) prev_fit$ate else NULL, contrast)
    data.frame(
      Fit = letter,
      Contrast = contrast,
      `ATE prev` = fmt_ate(old$mean),
      `ATE curr` = fmt_ate(cur$mean),
      `Delta (curr-prev)` = fmt_ate(cur$mean - old$mean),
      `rho prev` = fmt_num(fit_rho(prev_fit, prev_cfg$BETA_GR), 4),
      `rho curr` = fmt_num(fit_rho(cur_fit, cfg$BETA_GR), 4),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  ate_diff <- rbind(
    ate_diff_row("C", fit_C, prev_C, "all_or_nothing"),
    ate_diff_row("D", fit_D, prev_D, "all_or_nothing"),
    ate_diff_row("C", fit_C, prev_C, "observed"),
    ate_diff_row("D", fit_D, prev_D, "observed")
  )
  kable(ate_diff, align = "llrrrrr",
        caption = "ATE / spectral radius: previous vs current.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

  pc0 <- param_vec(prev_C)
  pd0 <- param_vec(prev_D)
  nms2 <- unique(c(names(pc), names(pd), names(pc0), names(pd0)))
  nms2 <- c(intersect(param_order, nms2), setdiff(nms2, param_order))
  param_diff <- data.frame(
    Parameter = nms2,
    `C prev` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) fmt_num(pc0[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
    `C curr` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) fmt_num(pc[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
    `C delta` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) {
      a <- safe_num(pc0[[nm]]); b <- safe_num(pc[[nm]])
      if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b)) "N/A" else fmt_num(b - a, 5)
    }, character(1)),
    `D prev` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) fmt_num(pd0[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
    `D curr` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) fmt_num(pd[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
    `D delta` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) {
      a <- safe_num(pd0[[nm]]); b <- safe_num(pd[[nm]])
      if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b)) "N/A" else fmt_num(b - a, 5)
    }, character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  kable(param_diff, align = "lrrrrrr",
        caption = "Parameter deltas (current − previous).") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
}
```
